decisive_items: Granulomatous inflammation with intense neutrophilic abscesses in subcutaneous fat
Widespread fibrinoid exudates within deeper tissues
response.rationale: The combination of granulomatous inflammation, dermal oedema, and fibrinoid exudates supports the diagnosis of necrobiotic xanthogranuloma, while the presence of deep dermal mucin and rippled skin appearance also supports scleromyxedema, but the overall clinical and pathological findings are more consistent with necrobiotic xanthogranuloma

rejected.why: Periorbital swelling and tumorous swellings are not specific to relapsing polychondritis
Multicentric reticulohistiocytosis typically presents with more pronounced histiocytic infiltration
Sjögren's syndrome typically presents with more prominent glandular involvement
